P.title: Template:Data Gwen/A Thousand Cuts

{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|A Thousand Cuts|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Gwen
|skill        = I
|icon         = A Thousand Cuts.png
|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Gwen's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}}, the center of ''{{ai|Snip Snip!|Gwen}}'', and ''{{ai|Needlework|Gwen}}'' deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{as|1% {{as|(+ {{fd|0.6}}% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health}}.
|description2 = ''A Thousand Cuts'' is modified based on the target:
* {{tip|heal|Heals}} '''Gwen''' for 67% of {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after resistances and most modifiers.}} dealt against {{tip|champion|champions}}, capped at {{pplevel|12 to 40}} {{as|(+ 7% AP)}} per instance.
* Deals an additional {{as|{{pplevel|8 to 30}} '''bonus''' magic damage}} against {{tip|minions}} that are {{as|'''below''' 40% health}}.
* Deals a maximum of {{as|3 {{as|(+ 5% AP)}} magic damage|magic damage}} against {{tip|monsters}}.
|blurbicon    = A Thousand Cuts.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Gwen}} {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and damaging abilities deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{as|a portion of the target's '''maximum''' health}} and {{tip|heal}} her for a portion of this damage dealt against {{tip|champions}}.

W.name: Hallowed Mist
W.title: Template:Data Gwen/Hallowed Mist
W.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Hallowed Mist|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Gwen
|skill        = W
|icon         = Hallowed Mist.png
|blurbicon    = Hallowed Mist.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Gwen}} summons the ''Hallowed Mist'' upon her current location for a few seconds. ''Hallowed Mist'' can be recast within this time, and does so automatically if she attempts to leave the area.
|blurb2       = While inside the mist, '''Gwen''' becomes {{tip|ghosted}}, gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}} and is {{tip|untargetable}} to enemies who are outside of it.
|blurb3       = {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Gwen''' commands the mist to move to her current location.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Gwen''' summons the Hallowed Mist upon her current location, lasting for 4 seconds. ''Hallowed Mist'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds, and does so automatically if '''Gwen''' attempts to leave the area.
|icon2        = Hallowed Mist 2.png
|description2 = While inside the mist, '''Gwen''' becomes {{tip|ghosted}}, gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}} and is {{tip|untargetable}} to all enemies (except {{tip|turret|turrets}} and {{tip|monsters}}) outside of the mist.
|leveling2    = {{st|Bonus Resistances|{{ap|22 to 30}} {{as|(+ 7% AP)}}}}
|description3 = {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Gwen''' commands the mist to move to her current location.
|description4 = '''''Gwen''' negates all attacks by {{tip|monsters}} outside of the mist.''
|cooldown     = {{ap|22 to 18}}
|cdstart      = post-effect
|cost         = 60
|costtype     = mana
|target range = 
|effect radius= {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 480
|speed        = {{tt|2000|Mist travel speed, teleports to Gwen if she is moving outside the zone faster than it can travel}}
|width        = 
|angle        = 
|cast time    = none
|queue time   = {{fd|0.5}}
|targeting    = Auto
|affects      = Self
|damagetype   = 
|spellshield  = 
|spelleffects = 
|grounded     = 
|projectile   = 
|callforhelp  = 
|notes        = 
* ''Hallowed Mist's'' {{tip|untargetability}} does not apply to {{tip|monster|monsters}} nor {{tip|turret|turrets}}, meaning they are allowed to gain aggro against '''Gwen''' and attack her regardless of being in the mist or not.
** However, '''Gwen''' will not take damage from monsters that hit her and are outside of the mist.
* ''Hallowed Mist'' does not grant untargetability against enemy {{tip|pet|pets}} inside the zone if their source is outside, but does grant untargetability against enemy ''pets'' outside the zone even if their source is inside.
* All {{tip|projectile|projectiles}} targeted at '''Gwen''' by enemy champions outside the mist are {{tip|homing projectile destruction|destroyed}} upon attempting to pass through the mist or being inside the mist.
** Targeted projectiles sourced by minions or monsters will not be destroyed and can still hit '''Gwen''' even if they are outside of the zone.
* If '''Gwen''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} out of the area, the mist will automatically move to the dash's destination instead of '''Gwen's''' location.
** The mist will stop moving immediately if the dash is interrupted.
* The recast will move the mist's center 75 units through '''Gwen's''' location at the time.
** If she is {{tip|dash|dashing}}, the mist will move 75 units through her dash destination instead.
* The mist will teleport to '''Gwen's''' location if she {{tip|blink|blinks}} a far distance.
* Enemy champions outside the mist are indicated with a broken sword.
* ''Hallowed Mist'' will indicate that '''''Gwen is Immune''''' whenever an effect attempts to hit '''Gwen'''.
}}
